newsitem.title: UK: Reed down after Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Reed down after Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Reed International Plc dropped sharply in early trade on Thursday as analysts at Merrill Lynch lowered the stock to "accumulate" from "buy" following a briefing with executives from the company, dealers said.
There was market talk that at least one other major brokerage was also planning to lower its earnings expectations for the media and publishing group.
Reed shares were down 29p at 596-1/2 by 0814 GMT in volume of just under one million shares.
Further detail was not immediately available. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
